mentions.place: Wilton Pl & Santa Monica Blvd (former Sears building), East Hollywood
mentions.speaker: Adali Schell
mentions.quote: we are in the intersection of Wilton and Santa Monica which is very close to where I grew up East Hollywood um this spot means something to me I think we should get out and maybe walk around here
mentions.note: Strongest pin in the episode. He names the exact intersection, gets out, and shoots: 1545 'this building this used to be a Sears... I've been photographing its kind of evolution', 1574 'have photos of it from a whole bunch of different years' (so it is also a haunt), 1626 'I'm going to try to maybe make a picture here', 1652 'we should turn the corner and I'll show you something else', 1681-1725 shooting trees / telephone lines / hand-painted signs / storefronts, 1823 'I've taken this photo before of this truck'. The closed Sears at Santa Monica Blvd near Wilton Pl / St Andrews Pl (verify exact corner on video: he says the building is 'behind us' and makes a U-turn). Recurs 1533-1834.

mentions.speaker: Adali Schell
mentions.quote: take Paulie to kind of where I grew up East Hollywood Los vas adjacent um go show you some of my favorite spots to shoot there that I kind of have been these very familiar lifelong place places
mentions.note: 'Los vas' = Los Feliz (caption garble). Neighborhood-level haunt; when asked how often he goes there (1032) he answers 'all the time'. The Wilton & Santa Monica stop is the concrete instance.

mentions.speaker: Adali Schell
mentions.quote: I've been hitting it again and again and it's been this thing kind of eating at me like man I could that needs more work
mentions.note: Spent two months shooting the river for NYT Magazine (3216-3235) and says he keeps returning to it as an ongoing project (3309 'I've been revisiting it recently'). Only driven past today (3254 'we about to drive by it'). It's a 51-mile corridor; the part he singles out as most interesting is 'where the river intersected the highway system' (3417-3423). No specific stretch named, so no pin.
